newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan non-life insurers sag on insurance pact.
newsitem.headline: Japan non-life insurers sag on insurance pact.

text.p: Shares in non-life insurers sagged in Monday morning trade, depressed by the settlement of the Japan-U.S. insurance talks on Saturday, brokers said.

As of 0138 GMT Sumitomo Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd shares were 18 yen down at 722 yen. Tokio Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd fell 10 yen to 1,130 yen. Mitsui Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd lost 15 yen to 635 yen.
"The outcome wasn't startling and the market should've digested the negotiations by now," a second-tier broker said.
"But the atmosphere of the market is so bad, non-life insures are being resold just on the fact the talks have been settled," he added.
